title.rendered: Kiierr Daily Hair Growth Products – MAX Hair Growth Supplements Bundle Autoship

content.rendered: Order today and see what our Kiierr Hair Growth Products – MAX Supplements Bundle can do for your hair! This bundle tackles hair loss from every supplemental angle to improve overall hair health.

excerpt.rendered:
Improves scalp circulation, blocks DHT & promotes hair growth. Includes Saw Palmetto, Horsetail Extract & Zinc formula helps slow/inhibit 5-AR enzyme conversion to DHT (primary cause of hair loss).
  • All natural ingredients
  • Enhanced with Vitamin B-6, Biotin, Folic Acid
  • Ideal for supplementing hair loss or thinning hair regimen
  • Contains Soy & Shellfish
  • Physician Formulated
Includes our popular DHT Blocking Shampoo, Hair Growth Conditioner, DHT Blocking Hair Growth Vitamins & delicious Biotin Gummies. Never run out. Sign up to ship this product monthly to your door!
